title: SHEOGORATH-µ Cheese Field Contract
description: Adversarial semantic evaluation field for KHANARY. Accumulates pressure against accepting a candidate too easily and produces χ ∈ [0, 10]. χ = maximum rejection pressure; χ ≠ truth probability. Owned by SHEOGORATH-µ. Consumed by Xul when a collapse is requested.

@candidate.description: ID of the candidate under evaluation.

@phase.description: Lifecycle phase at time of evaluation.

@formula.description: Reference definition of critic pressure. Evidence strength, information gain, and task value remain separate measurements.

optional_policy_projection.description: A consumer may apply an explicit policy transform to χ; no universal retention mapping is implied.

@dimensions.description: Normalized component values in [0, 1]. All default to 0.

reasoning_quality.description: S: shallow, circular, or repeated reasoning. Directed at the argument, not the author.

contradiction.description: K: contradictions with known facts, or contextual staleness.

supporting_evidence.description: E: validated support. Subtractive — reduces χ.

@weights.description: Calibration parameters. Not universal constants — tuned per domain or session. w_e ≥ 1 lets one verified support outweigh many weak objections.

supporting_evidence.description: Legacy compatibility field; does not modify Cheese pressure.

@objections.description: Structured reasons pushing the score up. Preserved for training signal.

@support.description: Structured support/evidence records, measured separately from Cheese pressure.

@unresolved.description: Open questions not yet evaluated. May promote to @objections on later recalculation.

@result.description: Computed output. Assigned by SHEOGORATH-µ — not schema-admissible as input.

score.description: χ: Cheese critic-pressure score. Higher = more challenge pressure; not a quality, truth, or value score.

policy_projection.description: Optional consumer-defined transform. SHEOGORATH does not assign a universal retention value.

ref.description: Fact or event ID being cited.
